# Requirements Readiness Checklist: Support Incident Reporting

**Purpose**: Validate that the 061 support incident reporting requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and ready for task-to-issue conversion.
**Created**: 2026-06-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests the English requirements, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are reportable, unavailable, and fallback custody states fully documented for `Отправить отчет` and `Скопировать отчет`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are all required report field categories documented with safe value classes and missing/redacted fallback values? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §SupportIncidentReport]
- [x] CHK003 Are server-side validation, redaction, persistence, tenant scope, reporter-safe identity, dedupe, status, and GitHub linkage requirements complete? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Are durable rate-limit bucket requirements documented separately from incident JSON storage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Data Model §SupportIncidentRateLimitBucket]
- [x] CHK005 Are private GitHub issue requirements complete for repo privacy, issue number, title, labels, body, update behavior, and closed-issue retention? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011..FR-017]
- [x] CHK006 Are native report action state requirements complete for initial, sending, sent, failed-with-copy-fallback, unavailable, refresh, and restart cases? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "metadata-only" defined through explicit allowed value classes and forbidden content rather than vague privacy language? [Clarity, Spec §Metadata-only policy, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Is user-visible success clearly tied to private GitHub issue creation or update rather than internal incident persistence alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK009 Is the `CUST-{github_issue_number}` incident number rule unambiguous for both created and deduped-updated incidents? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Contract §Success Response]
- [x] CHK010 Are fallback messages specified exactly enough to avoid blaming the user, exposing enum codes, or promising recording recovery? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK011 Are dedupe key inputs and forbidden raw identity inputs defined clearly enough to avoid incompatible dedupe implementations? [Clarity, Spec §Dedupe and aggregation, Data Model §SupportIncidentDedupeKey]
- [x] CHK012 Are rate-limit dimensions, timing ownership, and pre-GitHub-mutation behavior specified clearly enough to prevent unbounded ticket churn? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Data Model §SupportIncidentRateLimitBucket]
